notes: Reference date 2018-02-28. Usable sources: 2018_00 HR page; 2018_01 vacation; 2018_02 sick leave; 2018_03 LWOP; 2018_06 University Rule 12.01.99.M2; 2018_07 System Policy 12.01; 2018_08 FMLA regulation; 2018_09 sick leave pool; 2018_10 teaching-load guideline; 2018_11 DOF parental leave page; 2018_12 DOF tenure-clock page.

Governing documents for faculty leave are saved (System Regulations 31.03.01, 31.03.02, 31.03.04, 31.03.05, 31.06.01, the 2007 University teaching-load guideline, University Rule 12.01.99.M2), so `missing` is false (the condition of the rule for records with no governing document, reader instructions §3, is not met).

No institution-funded paid parental or maternity leave exists in the sources: the HR page states FMLA leave is unpaid and employees are paid from their own sick leave, vacation and compensatory time; 9-month (academic-year) faculty accrue no vacation, so their paid time during FMLA comes only from sick leave (pregnancy and confinement, or a father's care of the recovering mother); sick leave is not available for bonding.

The only faculty-specific benefit is the 2007 Parental Teaching Load Redistribution guideline (c8): 'should' arrange one/two semesters of relief from formal classroom teaching for a primary caregiver: discretionary under V2c (this guideline is V2c's own example), no stated pay (R3 flag).
Rule U8: Texas Parental Leave Act (Tex. Gov't Code 661.913) leave of up to 12 weeks for employees not eligible for FMLA is recorded in c1's duration_note, not as a component.

Version notes: the DOF parental-leave page is a 2019-10-18 capture (per its version note, the 2016-06-09 capture has the same substantive text); the DOF tenure-clock page is a 2018-05-18 capture inside the 2017-18 reference year; the FMLA regulation (rev. 2016-11-15) and sick leave pool regulation (rev. 2016-08-19) are 2021 captures of versions in force on the reference date per their version notes.

Cited but not saved: System Policy 31.03 Leaves of Absence; System Regulation 31.03.03 Leave of Absence With Pay (listed on the DOF parental leave page); 31.03.06 Military Leave and Service; 31.06.02 Sick Leave Donation; 31.01.09 Overtime; University Rule 12.03.99.M1 Faculty Workload Policy Statement; University Rules 12.01.99.M4, 08.01.01.M1, 15.99.03.M1; SAP 12.06.99.M0.01; System Policies 12.02, 12.06, 12.07; Rule 12.01.99.M2 Appendix I; Tex. Gov't Code 661.909, 661.912, 661.913 and ch. 661; 34 Tex. Admin. Code 5.43, 5.44; 29 C.F.R. Pt. 825; the HR Parental Leave Act packet (cover letter, certification form); 'Human Resources - Parental Leave for Faculty'; the Tenure Clock Extension Form; college extension requirements.

Sick Leave Reg. 3.7 (an ill employee may be required to take a leave of absence, using paid balances then leave without pay) is an employer-imposed leave, not a benefit; not coded. Sick Leave Reg. 3.3 (school activities) and the System Policy 12.01 administrative leave are not usable for a birth; not components.

Chain, birth parent: FMLA 12 workweeks (c1), with own sick leave (c2) and, for 12-month faculty only, vacation (c6) paid within it → sick leave pool (c4, discretionary, catastrophic only) after sick leave is exhausted → additional paid sick leave (c5, discretionary); in the discretionary variant, the semester of teaching relief (c8, 1-2 semesters) contains the FMLA leave (c1 within c8). Leave without pay (c7) and the tenure-clock extension (c9) are general-purpose and unlinked.

Chain, non-birth parent: FMLA 12 workweeks (c1) with own sick leave (c2, only to care for the recovering birth parent or an ill child; c4 and c5 for an immediate family member's catastrophic illness) within it; in the discretionary variant the teaching-relief semester (c8, primary caregiver only) contains c1.

Open point: the leave without pay (c7) is coded once, as a general-purpose leave (U1), although Sick Leave Reg. 3.8 points an employee unable to return after exhausting sick leave and vacation to it; it therefore adds no protected weeks for the birth parent. A separate medical-LWOP component (checklist §5 example 4) was considered and not created because 3.8 grants no leave of its own.
